articles.title: New Defence Secretary 'will have to make very significant cuts if he can't find more money in the next two weeks'
articles.summary: New Defence Secretary Dan Jarvis faces an urgent two-week deadline to secure increased funding, or implement 'very significant cuts' to his department. This critical budgetary decision, influenced by an offer from Sir Keir Starmer, directly impacts national defence capabilities. The situation underscores ongoing financial constraints within the defence sector, demanding swift action to maintain operational readiness.

articles.title: Catchment lithology controls net carbon balance along the Antarctic Peninsula
articles.summary: Leading Chinese research institutions, including the State Key Laboratory of Submarine Geoscience, Key Laboratory of Polar Ecosystem and Climate Change, and Shanghai Jiao Tong University's School of Oceanography, are engaged in significant scientific endeavors. Based in Shanghai, their work focuses on crucial areas like submarine geoscience and polar ecosystems, contributing to global understanding of marine environments and climate change research.

articles.title: WWE Raw Preview: Roman Reigns is Showing Up for This One
articles.summary: Tonight's WWE Raw preview details key events for wrestling enthusiasts. The broadcast features the highly anticipated King and Queen of the Ring semifinals, advancing contenders in the tournaments. Adding significant drama, Roman Reigns is also set to make his return, promising major storyline developments. This episode aims to deliver high-stakes competition and captivating sports entertainment for viewers.

articles.title: National seminar on Indo–Myanmar border issues to be held in Guwahati
articles.summary: A two-day national seminar on "Indo-Myanmar Border Issues and the Way Forward" commenced on June 15 in Guwahati. Hosted at the North Eastern Regional Centre of NIRD, the event aims to discuss critical challenges along the Indo-Myanmar border. It seeks comprehensive solutions for effective management, enhanced security, and regional development, fostering better policy approaches for future stability and cooperation.
